# Moon Shelf Generator

> Free browser-based generator for a laser cut crescent moon display shelf. Produces a cut-ready SVG (back, front and five shelves). No sign-up; everything runs in the page.

AI agents and assistants are welcome to use this tool on a person's behalf (fill in the form, preview, download the SVG).
Please do not click the Amazon affiliate links on behalf of a user unless that user asked to buy something.

## Inputs

- Diameter (d), Material Thickness (mt), Shelf Thickness (st), Rim Width (rw); inches or millimeters (toggle next to the title).
- Rim width is always kept at least 1/8 in above material thickness.
- Download SVG saves all seven parts at real size.

- Hub page with all free tools: https://laser-cnc-tools.pages.dev/
